emailBody: BEP Core Fund VIII fundraising memo is now close. Project Pure is oversubscribed. Project Care is under LOI.

attachments.name: BEP Core Fund VIII.pdf
attachments.text: BEP Core Fund VIII is a private equity fund. The target fund size is $350MM. The minimum LP commitment is $5MM. The fund held an initial close on $94.5MM in historical commitments. The $255.5MM difference between the target and historical commitments was unfunded at the time of the deck. The deck says the fund is open for new commitments. The portfolio includes control investments in business services and industrial companies. The term is ten years with extension options. Management fee is 2% during the investment period.

attachments.name: Project Pure Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Pure is a specialty ingredients co-investment. Revenue is $240M and adjusted EBITDA is $42M. Total co-investment availability is $80M-$105M. The deck describes allocations as open.

attachments.name: Project Care Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Care is an adult day health and HCBS co-investment. The business operates 54 centers serving 8,000 members. Total co-investment availability is approximately $150M-$165M. The deck describes the transaction as in diligence.
